mainEntity.name: What types of damages can be recovered in a wrongful death case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Damages in a wrongful death case can include economic and non-economic losses. Economic damages may cover funeral and burial expenses, medical bills incurred before death, loss of the deceased's expected income, and loss of household services. Non-economic damages compensate for emotional suffering, loss of companionship, comfort, affection, and moral support. The specific damages awarded depend on the unique circumstances of each case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recoverable damages in a wrongful death case can include funeral costs, lost income, medical bills, and compensation for emotional suffering and loss of companionship.
